name: Jabra Enhance Plus

price.headline: $799 per pair
price.note: OTC (over-the-counter) hearing aid; no prescription required

key_facts.label: Battery
key_facts.value: Rechargeable; up to 9 hours per charge

pros: Sleek design looks like earbuds, not traditional hearing aids
cons: Only suitable for mild to moderate hearing loss
Self-fitting may not be as precise as a clinical fitting
No telecoil for use with hearing loops
best_for: people with mild to moderate hearing loss who want a discreet, self-fit option
skip_if: you have severe or profound hearing loss; these devices are not appropriate and an audiologist visit is necessary
rating_reason: One of the better-designed OTC options at a mid-range price. The self-fit process is straightforward for most users. Not a replacement for a clinical evaluation if loss is significant.
